label: D1 during a reward streak early in the episode, with a moderate a2 policy lean
explanation: The unit is active almost only at D1 (98% of activation mass) and only when the reward input is 1 (prev_reward==1 covers 99.9% of mass). It never fires at GO and fires very rarely at D2. It does not fire after a single reward that follows a non-reward: requiring the two trials before also to be rewarded (or outside the window) loses no recall and raises precision a lot. So it tracks a streak of rewards. It is restricted to early episode trials (ep_trial < 30 holds about 89% of activations; it is silent after trial ~60). It fires when the model leans moderately toward a2 (D1 policy logit choice between -4.4 and -1.5, 96% of mass), mostly with S2 good and after a2 choices, and the value output is in a narrow mid-high band (7.54-7.73). Top activations include D1 after a rewarded a1/S1 trial within an a2 run. Activations are small (max 0.003). Dev P=0.50, R=0.88, F1=0.64, mass recall 0.85. The remaining false positives are other streak D1s with the same lean where it stays silent, so the episode-time / a2-lean gating is only approximately captured. Uses only observed variables and the model own policy logit.
